page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a distinct performance profile. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression categorized as poor. However, the instance leverages its 32 dedicated cores to achieve average multi-core performance, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores. Memory bandwidth also performs in the average tier, reaching 98.48 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 49.01 GB/sec for large block write operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for multi-threaded workloads that do not require high single-core throughput. The primary tradeoff is the lower single-threaded efficiency, meaning tasks bound by single-core speed will experience latency. However, for parallelized workloads, the dedicated core allocation ensures stable performance without resource contention.

This instance is suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, software compilation, and database operations. It is also capable of handling moderate Redis deployments and medium-sized LLM inference tasks, such as prompt processing and text generation for 7B models, where performance remains in the average tier.
